description: This file defines an interface for reading loan charge information within the FinFIC API, including methods for retrieving loan charge templates, details, payments, and related data.

classes.name: LoanChargeReadPlatformService
classes.description: Interface for loan charge retrieval operations in the loan account domain.

methods.name: retrieveLoanChargeTemplate
methods.description: Retrieves a template for loan charges, possibly for creating or displaying charge options.

methods.name: retrieveLoanCharges
methods.description: Retrieves all loan charges associated with a specified loan ID.

methods.name: retrieveLoanChargeDetails
methods.description: Provides detailed information for a specific loan charge, optionally within the context of a specific loan.

methods.name: retrieveLoanChargesForFeePayment
methods.description: Gets loan charges that are applicable for fee payment, filtered by payment mode and loan status.

methods.name: retrieveInstallmentLoanCharges
methods.description: Retrieves installment-specific loan charges, with an option to filter only pending payments.

methods.name: retrieveOverdueInstallmentChargeFrequencyNumber
methods.description: Retrieves frequency numbers for overdue installment charges for a given loan and charge, based on a period number.

methods.name: retrieveLoanChargesPaidBy
methods.description: Retrieves data about loans charges paid by a specific entity, filtered by charge ID, transaction type, and installment number.

methods.name: retrieveLoanChargeIdByExternalId
methods.description: Finds a loan charge ID based on an external identifier.
